text: Building the scenario: a plan that ended five days ago…

This plan has ended. Memories on Nursery camera ended on Oct 7, 2026, and the store hasn't reported a renewal. If you renewed, it may be on a different account; support can check the store's record. Sleep is still active.

Building the scenario: paid on the website, not on any camera…
Nursery camera: We found your plan. 2 of 5 checks verified; the camera check needs an action.
Connecting the purchase, then checking the camera…
Connected without a new purchase, then verified separately: NextNap, Sleep analysis work on the nursery camera.
Developmental milestones: the mount is fine, only the plan blocks it. This is the one case that shows an offer: Simulated Milestones plan — $300/year.
Moving the camera, then submitting the old offer…
The old offer is refused before any payment call: a plan can't fix a Flex Stand. Nothing was charged.
When the facts change, the answer changes, and the history stays. These cases come from parents' public reports: see Customer evidence.
